coachMessages.text: An immediate threat is a move that wins the game on the very next turn.

slides.infoProse: When you have three discs in a row with an open space at either end, you have an immediate threat. Playing in that space wins the game instantly.

coachMessages.text: Your opponent must block your threat — or you win on the spot!

slides.infoProse: In a real game, you have other discs on the board but your threat remains the priority. If your opponent ignores it, you win immediately.
